associations.note: AMS1117 input capacitor (AMS1117 p5 / LM1117 9.2.2.1.1): 10uF tantalum at the VIN pin, short lead. Linear regulator - no switch node, so NOT role=reg_input and no HF ceramic partner (block-only scope: not datasheet-required).

COMPENSATION element, NOT bypass: the AMS1117 output capacitor is part of the device frequency compensation and its ESR is the loop's stabilising zero (0.8 ohm @ 100 kHz, inside the 0.3-22 ohm window). Do not substitute a ceramic or a polymer tantalum, and do not change the value.
